chunks: And from his sermons (peace be upon him), he delivered it at Siffin.

key_terms.خُطْبَتِهِ: His sermon, referring to the oration delivered by Imam Ali.
key_terms.صِفِّينَ: Siffin, a location in Syria where the Battle of Siffin took place between Imam Ali and Muawiyah ibn Abi Sufyan.
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Peace be upon him, an honorific used for the Imams.

ai.seo_question: Where did Imam Ali deliver this specific sermon?
ai.summary: Delivered during the pivotal Battle of Siffin (657 CE), this sermon articulates Imam Ali’s (AS) theological and political justification for his caliphate against Muawiyah, emphasizing the divine right of leadership (Imamah) and the mutual obligations between the ruler and the ruled. It serves as a foundational text in Shia jurisprudence for understanding the concept of *Haqq* (right) and the ethical duties of governance, distinguishing Ali’s rule from the subsequent Umayyad dynasty.
